message: 覚醒
I positioned myself to shield Azel and faced off against the Female Demon.

name: Synn
message: 「Who are you!」
The woman lightly bit the pinky of her right hand. A few drops of blood splattered at her feet.
A chilling voice was spun from her blood-wet lips.

name: Female Demon
message: 「Does it really matter who I am? You're going to die soon anyway.」
She looked somehow familiar.
And when it came to a female demon who, judging by her figure, wasn't Pasta......

name: Synn
message: 「Sengen'in-sensei!?」

name: Female Demon
message: 「O circle of my dominion, pour the chaos flowing within thee into me!」
The splattered fresh blood burst into flames,
Flames raced around the woman's feet, and an eerie pattern emerged.

name: Melilot
message: 「Soltia!?」

name: Helena
message: 「She appeared?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes.」
Helena set down her pool cue and picked up her cell phone.

name: Helena
message: 「It won't connect.」

name: Melilot
message: 「The magic circles placed throughout Ryuusei Town have likely activated all at once. To think she would go this far......」

name: Helena
message: 「Should I call Tamiko-chan?」

name: Melilot
message: 「She is not an opponent a human can match.」

name: Helena
message: 「I wonder if Bylous will show up too?」

name: Melilot
message: 「That I do not know. However, I must go.」

name: Helena
message: 「No running away while losing, okay?」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is no such thing as running away while losing. We will continue later.」
Just as three dazzling points of light appeared behind the woman, they turned into three pale-blue beams hurtling straight toward me!
I readied my weapon on reflex and deflected them away!
The deflected beams struck all across the park, setting the trees ablaze.
My arms go numb. It's a heavy attack that feels like it could strip away all my strength.

name: Female Demon
message: 「You really have grown, haven't you? However.」

name: Female Demon
message: 「How will you handle this?」
Over ten points of light rose up behind the woman.
Can I withstand it?
Even so, I can't afford to back down.
Azel is right behind me. She seems unable to move, likely frozen from sheer shock.
I won't let Azel get hurt, no matter what.
Countless arrows made of light come hurtling toward me.
Calm down! Remember your special training!
I barely managed to weather it! Using magic should require replenishing mana.
Now it's my turn--
She can fire in rapid succession!?

name: Melilot
message: 「Soltia!」

name: Bylous
message: 「I've been waiting for you, witch.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Bylous...」

name: Bylous
message: 「You won't reach the Demon Lord unless you defeat me.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Bylous
message: 「So it is as I thought.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Care to dance with me, witch?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I have no time to dance with you.」

name: Bylous
message: 「How cold. Still, I don't mind taking things by force.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I have no time to indulge in your nonsense.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Interesting!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Acceleration magic, huh?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You can still keep up even with this!?」

name: Bylous
message: 「Once your intentions are clear, predicting you is easy.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then I will simply surpass them!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I should be moving faster than your eyes can track... What a monster.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Being praised by a witch makes me proud.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Persistent men are disliked, you know.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Because I want to dance with you at all costs.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ugh!」
Melilot's body was blown away!

name: Bylous
message: 「Repeating the same steps gets boring.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Persistent and easily bored--that makes you quite a hopeless man.」
The two kept their distance, facing off.

name: Melilot
message: 「Huff, huff, huff...」

name: Bylous
message: 「Now, what will you do next?」
Melilot's right hand rose smoothly.

name: Melilot
message: 「Bind!」
Red light turned into ropes and bound Bylous tightly

name: Bylous
message: 「I see. Those movements that seemed pointless earlier were to weave this.」

name: Bylous
message: 「However, a barrier of this level.」
With a completely natural gesture, Melilot slipped her hand into her skirt pocket and pulled out a penlight.
Caught off guard, Bylous's gaze was drawn to the tip of the penlight as it began to glow.

name: Melilot
message: 「Look.」
The hand holding the penlight danced.
The glowing tip etched a sharp afterimage into Bylous's vision.

name: Melilot
message: 「Burn.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Aghhhhhhhhh.」
Bylous burst into flames.

name: Melilot
message: 「I hate persistent men.」
The flames of Bylous, now like a human torch, illuminated Melilot as she walked away.
The flames erupting from his entire body were destroying the physical vessel he needed to remain in the Human World.

name: Bylous
message: 「Hahaha! Yes, yes! Now this is more like it!」
Melilot stopped in her tracks.

name: Bylous
message: 「Koooooooooh!」
The flames gushing from Bylous's body rapidly subsided.
The color drained from Melilot's face.

name: Melilot
message: 「Impossible?!」

name: Bylous
message: 「Using the afterimages of penlights to draw a magic circle inside your opponent's mind, activating it, and detonating the magic power stored inside their body, huh...」

name: Bylous
message: 「After all, a magic circle will activate as long as it forms a complete image, even for an instant.」

name: Bylous
message: 「And the larger the target's mana pool, the more effective it is.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Are you saying you suppressed it through sheer brute force?!」
Bylous's arm flashed.
The barrier restraining him shattered effortlessly.

name: Bylous
message: 「If it had formed a complete image, I wouldn't have been able to hold it back.」

name: Melilot
message: 「To figure out the principle behind it and shift your position in that brief instant...」

name: Bylous
message: 「I didn't figure anything out. Shifting out of alignment was pure reflex.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...You berserker.」

name: Bylous
message: 「Now then, I wonder if the Demon Lord has been killed yet?」

name: Melilot
message: 「As if I would let that happen!」
Without answering Melilot's cry, Bylous muttered.

name: Bylous
message: 「If he has, what a boring curtain call.」

name: Bylous
message: 「I have no need for a Demon Lord who would lose to the likes of Soltia.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gwaaaaaaah!」
I heard Azel's anguished murmur from behind me.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm... fine...」
I used my weapon as a crutch and pushed myself to my feet.
Was that my own blood dripping down along my weapon?

name: Sengen'in-sensei?
message: 「Impressive that you're still alive.」

name: Synn
message: 「Something like this... won't bring me down.」
I can't feel about half of my body.
The taste of blood is spreading inside my mouth, too.
This isn't from biting the inside of my mouth. It feels like one of my internal organs got hit.
My pants are sticking to my legs with blood, feeling both cold and hot.

name: Azel
message: 「Stop... already...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, can you move yet?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Stop it... please stop...」
Doesn't look like it yet.
If I move out of the way, the beams will hit Azel.
I have to buy time until Azel can move.
Behind the Female Demon, a sickening number of points of light floated into view.

name: Sengen'in-sensei?
message: 「If you're going to hate someone, hate God. In other words, the woman behind you.」
Countless pale-blue spears of light are closing in!
My arms and legs could barely move anymore.
So there was only one thing I could do.
I couldn't stay standing.
There wasn't any pain or anything. Or maybe it hurt so much that all sensation just vanished.
Both of my knees hit the ground on their own.
I couldn't keep my head up, and when I looked down, for some reason I could see Azel.
Even though I hadn't turned around, I could see Azel, who was supposed to be behind me.
Huh, that's weird. That's weird.
Still, it looks like Azel is okay. Becoming a shield wasn't in vain.

name: Azel
message: 「Ah... ah... Synn... Synn...」
I tried to say something, but blood welled up in my mouth and I couldn't speak.
Ah, I see.
I figured out why I could see Azel without even turning around.
There's a huge hole blown through my chest

name: Azel
message: 「No! No! Not like this, nooooooooo!」

name: Melilot
message: 「This phenomenon! This surge! Re-Crea?!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Gah!」
Melilot was blown away by the raging force, and Bylous laughed amidst the frenzied world.

name: Bylous
message: 「Hahahaha! I see! So that's how it is! Indeed, the world is both cruel and comical.」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't want this! No, no, noooo!」
All five senses suddenly came rushing back to me.

name: Sengen'in-sensei?
message: 「W-Why... why are you coming back to life?!」

name: Synn
message: 「You made Azel cry!」
Was the heat surging through my body rage, or was it power?
Surely, it was both.

name: Azel
message: 「Synn! Synn!」

name: Sengen'in-sensei?
message: 「You've awakened?! No... it can't be!」
Even without looking, I could tell Azel had collapsed on the ground.
I could tell the Female Demon in front of me was terrified.
I could even tell every single tree in the park that had fallen and every single one that was burning.
I could also tell there was another demon possessing immense power in the park.
I picked up my weapon and stood up.

name: Synn
message: 「Keep your hands off Azel!」
The heat blazing inside me swelled up.
It expanded, spilling past the confines of my physical body.
With my entire body burning hot from that power, I broke into a run.

name: Sengen'in-sensei?
message: 「Still, in that form... kh!」
Twenty-four points of light materialized behind the Female Demon.
It was a power so feeble that pity welled up even within my rage-dominated heart.
With my weapon, I batted away the spears of light creeping toward me so sluggishly a fly could have landed on them.
I even had the composure to deflect them skyward so the park wouldn't suffer any further damage.
